media.title: Klip Media — Digital Marketing in South Florida | KLIP
media.description: Klip Media is KLIP's marketing division: Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, GEO and AI search, social media, branding, website design, AI solutions and content strategy.

blocks.imageAlt: Klip Media team on a client content shoot
headline: Turn Visibility
Into Growth
blocks.body: Strategy, content and technology working together. We build the plan, produce the work, put it in front of the right people and measure what it returns.

headline: Nine Ways We Build
Your Visibility
blocks.body: Pick one, or let us build the mix around your goals.

items.title: Google Ads
items.text: Capture the people already searching for what you do. Search, Performance Max and local campaigns, managed against cost per lead rather than clicks.

items.title: Meta Ads
items.text: Facebook and Instagram campaigns built around creative that actually stops the scroll — because we shoot it ourselves.

items.title: SEO
items.text: Technical fixes, on-page structure, service and location pages, and the content that earns rankings over time.

items.title: GEO / AI Search
items.text: Get found inside AI answers. Entity clarity, structured data, crawler access and answer-ready content. GEO complements SEO — it does not replace it.

items.title: Social Media
items.text: Planning, production, publishing and community management. Consistent presence without you running the account.

items.title: Branding
items.text: Positioning, identity, messaging and the visual system that makes you recognisable across every channel.

items.title: Website Design
items.text: Fast, modern sites built to convert and to be found, with the technical foundations search and AI both need.

items.title: AI Solutions
items.text: Automation and AI workflows for follow-up, lead routing, reporting and the busywork that eats your week.

items.title: Content Strategy
items.text: A clear plan for what to create, where to publish and why — tied to business goals, not vanity metrics.

items.title: Audit
items.text: We look at where you show up today — search, AI answers, social, paid — and where you do not.

items.title: Plan
items.text: A written plan with the channels, the content and what each one is meant to do.

items.title: Produce
items.text: We shoot, edit and build in house. No waiting on a third party.

items.title: Report
items.text: Plain-language reporting on what moved and what we are changing next.

studio.title: Klip Studio — Podcast, Video & Photo Studio in Fort Lauderdale | KLIP
studio.description: Klip Studio is KLIP's production space in Fort Lauderdale: multicam podcast room, dark interview room, green screen and a white wall for photo and product. Book by the hour.

blocks.imageAlt: Klip Studio podcast set with lighting and crew
headline: Create Here
blocks.body: Four rooms built for podcasts, video, photography, creator content, courses, live selling and branded production.

headline: Four Spaces.
One Address
blocks.body: Each room is set up and ready. Self-service, or with a technician. Pick the look, book the hour.

headline: Everything Is Already
Set Up

items.title: Professional Equipment
items.text: Cameras, lighting and audio configured and tested before you arrive.

items.title: Easy Booking
items.text: Pick your room and your hour online. Confirmation is instant.

items.title: Free Parking
items.text: On-site parking for you and your guests. Coffee and water are on us.

items.title: Self or Full Service
items.text: Run the room yourself, add a technician, or hand the whole production to us — planning, coaching, scripts, editing and clips.

items.title: Creators + Live Commerce
items.text: Create reels, UGC, product demos, TikTok Shop content and live-selling sessions in a production-ready space.

items.title: Courses + Education
items.text: Record courses, masterclasses, lessons and training content with professional cameras, lighting and audio.

about.title: About KLIP — Content & Marketing in South Florida
about.description: KLIP is a content and digital marketing company in Fort Lauderdale. Klip Media runs the marketing, Klip Studio runs the production, and both sit under one roof.

blocks.imageAlt: KLIP reception lounge with seating under the neon sign
headline: More Than
A Studio
blocks.body: KLIP is a content and digital marketing company built to help businesses become more visible and grow — backed by our own production studio and on-location team.

blocks.imageAlt: The Klip Studio team on set
headline: Two Divisions.
One Company
blocks.body: Most businesses have to hire an agency for the strategy and a studio for the production, then hope the two talk to each other. We do both.

points.title: KLIP Media
points.text: The marketing side — ads, search, social, branding, websites and automation.

points.title: KLIP Studio
points.text: The production side — Podcast, video, photography, creator content, courses, live selling and on-location production.

points.title: Together
points.text: The people who plan the campaign are the people who shoot it.

items.title: Accessibility
items.text: Professional content should be available to everyone. We remove the technical, financial and creative barriers.

items.title: Simplicity
items.text: Clear, streamlined processes that make content creation easy and repeatable rather than stressful.

items.title: Empowerment
items.text: We guide creators and brands so they can focus on the message and show up professionally.
